Back to Saia em 20

A small plan.
An open model.

Saia em 20 means “go outside in 20.” Pick a familiar place, choose your time, and describe what you want from your break. An open multilingual model compares your preference with a small activity catalog on your device. Save the pocket card and put the screen away.

What the AI actually does

multilingual-e5-small runs through Transformers.js 4.3.0 in a Web Worker using WASM and q8 weights. It converts your preference and activity descriptions into vectors, then ranks allowed activities by cosine similarity. Mean pooling and normalized vectors follow the model authors' retrieval guidance. Similarity scores are not confidence percentages.

Your goal filters candidates. A seated preference always excludes walking before inference; sitting takes precedence when it conflicts with movement. The final activity is validated against those candidates. Activity instructions are authored in Portuguese and English. Semantic matching can misinterpret negation or vague requests, but it cannot override the mobility filter or invent a route.

Privacy and offline use

No GPS, accounts, analytics, or inference server are required. Your place and preferences stay in your browser. Hosting/CDN providers serve application files; Hugging Face serves the model download. Those providers see ordinary request metadata. The first run needs internet and approximately 135 MB for the model and tokenizer, plus runtime files.

Browser caches store app and model files. Offline reuse depends on retained caches and space. A downloaded pocket card is self-contained and opens without loading a model. Cache eviction may require another download. The timer saves the active plan and its original end time so a page reload resumes the pause. Changes to the device clock can affect the countdown.

Clear origin

Successful inference exposes the model, revision, ranked IDs, cosine scores and measured runtime in the plan details. If inference fails, an optional catalog suggestion is clearly marked “No AI.” Optional reflections stay on this device; storage errors are reported. No completed user study or verified outdoor trial is claimed.
